title: Notice to All Non-settling Manufacturers
text:
MISSISSIPPI DEPARTMENT OF REVENUE
Sales and Use Tax Bureau Notice 72-26-10 July 1, 2026
NOTICE OF NONSETTLING MANUFACTURER FEE RATE
INCREASE
There is a non-settling manufacturer (NSM) fee rate increase on returns filed for the July
2026 filing period forward. Miss. Code Ann. § 27-70-5 provides that on July 1 of each
year the NSM fee will increase by the greater of three percent (3%) or, the most recent
annual revised Consumer Price Index for all Urban Consumers as published by the Federal
Bureau of Labor Statistics of the United States Department of Labor. The Consumer Price
Index for calendar year 2025 was 2.7%; therefore, the NSM fee rate will be increased by
3%.
In accordance with this provision, the NSM fee will increase from two and twenty
hundredths cents (2.20) for each NSM cigarette to two and twenty-seven hundredths cents
(2.27) for each NSM cigarette effective July 1, 2026. This will result in an increase of
$0.14 per carton. The July 2026 return and all future returns have been updated to reflect
this change.
If you have any questions, please contact the Sales Tax Department at 601-923-7015.
P.O. Box 1033 Jackson, Mississippi 39215 Phone: 601-923-7015 FAX: 601-923-7034
